{"metadata":{"description":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）嵌入 Obsidian 的 AI 协作者插件：聊天侧边栏、内联编辑、@提及与计划模式（连接本地 http://127.0.0.1:3080）","id":"gh:1334128395","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-obsidian","slug":"wozoulesky/dsh-obsidian","topics":["agent","ai-assistant","deepseek","dsh","dsh-plugin","obsidian","obsidian-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）嵌入 Obsidian 的 AI 协作者插件：聊天侧边栏、内联编辑、@提及与计划模式（连接本地 http://127.0.0.1:3080）"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Embed your locally running DeepSeek Harness (DSH) into Obsidian as an AI collaborator: your vault be"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"comes its working directory, and DSH can read, write, and search your notes directly."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this plugin"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Most Obsidian ↔ agent bridges wrap a web UI or shell out to a CLI. This one is a **native client**: "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"it speaks DSH's own RPC and event stream, then renders everything with Obsidian's own UI."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Native, not embedded** — chat, tool cards, approvals and plan mode are real Obsidian UI: your th"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"eme, your fonts, your hotkeys.
- **Inline edit with a word-level diff** — select text, give an instr"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"uction, review the diff, apply; `Cmd+Z` undoes it.
- **Approvals land where you are** — DSH's write/"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"exec confirmations and its questions appear inside the panel, no window switching, and they survive "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"a reconnect.
- **Connection diagnosis** — `401` / `404` / connection-refused are translated into an "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"actionable conclusion (Settings → *Diagnose connection*).
- **Engineered to last** — 550+ unit tests"},{"id":"p7s7","text":", strict TypeScript build, byte-reproducible artifacts, listed in the community directory."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin is a client, not a runtime: it needs a local DSH to talk to (see Prerequisites). If somet"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"hing looks wrong, the diagnose button will tell you which of the two it is."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- A running DSH instance on your machine. **Don't worry about the port**: since DSH 0.2.1 the deskto"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"p app is assigned a **random port on each launch** (it used to pin `19387`), and the `dsh web` comma"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"nd defaults to `3080`. The plugin **auto-discovers** the real port on startup — it tries the static "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"candidates first, then reverse-resolves the Cookie store that the DSH desktop app writes, to locate "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"the random port — and saves it back to settings — **you normally don't need to type an address**. It"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" also **re-discovers while running**: restart DSH without touching Obsidian and the plugin notices t"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"he connection repeatedly failing, finds the new port, and switches over on its own (typically ~4s) —"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" **no reload needed**
- Your vault must be inside DSH's accessible directory scope (decided by DSH's"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" sandbox / workspace config)
- **Obsidian ≥ 1.7.2, desktop build only**. These are two different con"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"straints:
- `1.7.2` is an Obsidian **version** requirement (sidebar `revealLeaf` and related APIs). "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"Upgrade Obsidian if you are below it.
- "Desktop build" is an Obsidian **client-form** requirement, "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"unrelated to the version: the plugin signs its auth cookie with the secret in `~/.dsh/.credentials.y"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"aml`, and mobile has no Node filesystem access, so it cannot sign one. Hence `isDesktopOnly: true`.
"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"- **This does not constrain how you run DSH**: auth uses the same `client-connection/browser-session"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"` secret in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, regardless of whether DSH runs as the desktop app or via `ds"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"h web`; `3080` (the `dsh web` default) is already a built-in static candidate. The desktop app is fu"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"lly verified on real hardware; `dsh web` follows the same auth and protocol path but has **not been "},{"id":"p10s18","text":"separately end-to-end tested** (see the compatibility table below)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Conversation**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Chat sidebar** — streamed responses, tool-call cards, session switching and creation, "load olde"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"r" pagination, and automatic re-sync after reconnects
- **Approval & question popups** — retryable, "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"grouped per session, replayed after a reconnect
- **Thinking process** — collapsible reasoning block"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" above each reply, streamed live and folded once the turn completes
- **Image attachments** — attach"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" images from your vault to a prompt; the agent reads them directly"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Editing your notes**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Inline edit** — select text + hotkey → instruction → word-level diff preview → apply (editor sel"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ection is re-validated before applying; large selections degrade to a plain confirm dialog)
- **@men"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"tions** — type `@` to pick vault files (`@file:path`, content injected) or folders (`@folder:path`, "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"directory tree injected), with truncation and missing-file notices
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Privacy"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"All data flows through your local DSH to its configured model providers, using the same policy as th"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e DSH Web GUI. The plugin sends no telemetry."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### DSH compatibility"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| DSH version line | Plugin version | Status |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| **0.2 line** (verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`) | 0.1.8+ (current) | ✅ **Protocol-layer verification and i"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"n-Obsidian UI acceptance both pass** (2026-10-01): the plugin's own code connected to a live 0.2.0-r"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"c.2 over real HTTP + WebSocket — authentication, all 18 RPC endpoints, and the `$events` / `session/"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"control` / `session/follow` streams pass; and a real Obsidian 1.13.7 accepted @-mentions, streaming "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"output, approval-gated file writes, inline-edit diff, and port auto-detection. **0.2 did not change "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"auth, the RPC envelope, or the WS frame protocol**, so no upgrade work is needed. The one gotcha is "},{"id":"p20s7","text":"the port: the desktop app used to pin 19387 but **since 0.2.1 it is assigned a random port on each l"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"aunch** (`dsh web` still defaults to 3080) — the plugin **auto-discovers** it (static candidates fir"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"st, then reverse-resolving the desktop app's Cookie store), so you normally don't set it by hand. Pe"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"r-item record and verification boundaries: docs/dsh-0.2-compat-audit-2026-10-01.md (see its expiry n"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"ote for the port claim) |
| **0.1.5 line** (verified on `0.1.5-rc.1`) | 0.1.6+ (incl. 0.1.7) | ✅ **V"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"erified end to end** on a real vault (2026-09-13): streamed output, approvals, inline-edit diff, rec"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"onnect |
| **`dsh web` launch mode** (defaults to port 3080) | 0.2.0+ | ⚠️ **not separately end-to-e"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"nd tested**. Auth, RPC envelope, and WS frame protocol are identical to the desktop app (same `clien"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"t-connection/browser-session` secret in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`), and `3080` is already the first"},{"id":"p20s16","text":" built-in static candidate, so it is expected to work; but as of 0.2.0 it has not been run through f"},{"id":"p20s17","text":"ull acceptance on a real `dsh web` instance. Please open an issue if you hit problems. |
| **0.1.2 l"},{"id":"p20s18","text":"ine** (`0.1.2-rc.1`, `0.1.2`) | 0.1.5+ | ✅ **Supported** — the contract this plugin was built agains"},{"id":"p20s19","text":"t. 0.1.6+ keeps it working through capability probing: the 0.1.5 streaming channel is requested fiel"},{"id":"p20s20","text":"d by field and dropped automatically if the server rejects it. Verified on a real machine at plugin "},{"id":"p20s21","text":"0.1.5, covered by unit tests since |
